policy.support_boundary: Applicability rules decide whether a profile supports an operation/type tuple. They do not define numeric result semantics.
policy.rejection_boundary: The six A2/A3 MX CUBE rules reject with IllegalInstruction before operand legality, handler dispatch, or operation effects.
policy.parent_boundary: This checkpoint closes only a negative A2/A3 support slice. PD-01, cube-matrix result rules, and S5-T2 remain open.

profiles.accepted_scope: The six MX CUBE operation selectors are unsupported by A2/A3 for every architectural TileDataType and reject before operation effects.

profile_identity.role: A2A3 support restrictions and explicitly delegated bounded numeric rules.
profile_identity.selection: Requires a complete A2A3 operation/type legality matrix and one accepted result rule for every supported tuple.
profile_identity.relation_to_pto_v0: Future alternative target profile distinct from pto-v0; pto-v0 raw-carrier results are not inherited as hardware arithmetic.

public-target-profiles.role: published CPU, A2A3, and A5 capability partition

a5-matrix.role: A5 matrix instruction and MX implementation evidence

independent_executable_model.role: structural corroboration only; no tile payload or numeric result oracle
